findings.title: Opening a mounts tab still saves an entry for every mount on it
findings.detail: Apply now reads tunings without adding entries, so XML and balance patches apply to mounts with no saved entry. But DoMounts calls Settings.TuningFor(def) for every mount def as the Manned/Automated tab is drawn. TuningFor adds the missing entry and WriteSettings saves it when the window closes, so just viewing a tab records the XML values for every mount listed. A later balance patch to those mounts is then ignored. The slider-only-snaps change is right but doesn't stop this. Fix in DoMounts: show a copy (tunings entry, else Defaults[def.defName].Copy()) and only write it into tunings when a slider changes it.

findings.title: Settings files from builds 1-6 already hold an entry for every mount
findings.detail: The old Apply called TuningFor (Source/MountSettings.cs:64) for every mount def, which added and saved an entry for each. The read-without-adding change doesn't remove them, so on any install that ran builds 1-6 the XML values stay frozen until Reset. No release tag contains HEAD, so this may only affect the author's own test settings.
